facts.fact: The BCEAO communique of 2 October 2026, for the whole WAEMU, sets binding terms for person-to-person e-money transfers through PI-SPI, taking effect on 2 November 2026 (free sends up to FCFA 8,000 a day, 0-0.8% above, free receipt).

The BCEAO decided that from 2 November 2026 interoperable e-money transactions within WAEMU must be made through the PI-SPI platform, covering transfers between bank or microfinance accounts and accounts at e-money institutions or payment establishments.

systems.tiers: banks, microfinance institutions, e-money institutions, payment establishments
